column1: # The .gitignore lines TechieFlow manages, in ONE place (FW-2026-11-08).
# Read by scaffold-greenfield.sh, scaffold-brownfield.sh and update-framework.sh (through
# .tfcore/utils/tf-gitignore-blocks.sh) and by the Node installer scripts/install.mjs. Until this
# file existed each of the four carried its own copy of these lines; on 2026-11-05 the three shell
# scripts gained tests/verify/testsettings.Local.json, the installer did not, and npm run
# test:install failed six checks on every runner. One list cannot drift from itself.
# Format: tab-separated, one entry per line.
#   @<block>  <header comment written above the block>  <label printed in the script's output>
#   <block>   <line written to .gitignore>              <extended regex: a line already present that matches it counts>
# The regex is read by grep -E (bash) and by new RegExp (Node): keep to the common subset
# (^ $ ? . * | ( ) [ ] and backslash escapes). Lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped.
# Order matters: entries are appended in the order listed. Append-only and idempotent: an entry
# whose pattern already matches a line is never written twice, and nothing is ever rewritten.
